# Needle

Needle provides retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) tools that enable semantic search across your data, facilitating the development of AI agents and applications.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/needle/.

## Actions

- **Create Collection**: Create a new collection.
- **Delete files from a collection**: Delete files from a specific collection by providing file ids.
- **List Collection Files** (read-only): List all files within a specific collection by its id.
- **List Collections** (read-only): List collections.
- **Get collection stats** (read-only): Retrieve statistics for a specific collection by its id.
